### Menubar
An application's row of menus, such as File, Edit and View, with the menubar keyboard contract.

Component ID: `menubar`

Package: `@expressivecss/extras`, not core. Install it next to `@expressivecss/expressive` and load its CSS and JS after core; see [install and load order](../SKILL.md#install-and-load-order).

[Component documentation](https://www.expressivecss.com/menubar.html.md) · [Repository source](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/blob/master/docs/src/pages/menubar.astro) · [Matching tag](https://github.com/BaezFJ/ExpressiveCSS/tree/v0.20.0)

Contract: ExpressiveCSS 0.20.0

#### Selection and adaptation

Runtime ownership: `auto-init`. No dedicated entry in the reviewed Google component inventory.

Public JavaScript exports: `Menubar`. See the [API index](../references/api-index.md).

Example: File, Edit and View in a document editor are a menubar. One "More" button with five actions is a single menu.

#### Material mapping

Relationship: none. Web extension; no dedicated entry was observed in the reviewed current M3 component inventory.

Support: A menubar of menu triggers with one tab stop, Left, Right, Home and End along the bar, Down to open, and Left and Right between open menus.

Web adaptation: Each item opens an ordinary Menu; the Menubar component adds the menubar and menuitem roles and the roving tab stop at runtime.

Full parity remains unassessed. Review provenance and specification links: [capability evidence](../references/capability-roadmap.md#menubar).

#### Contract

A `.menubar` holds `.menu-trigger` buttons, each opening an ordinary Menu written after the bar. The `Menubar` component sets `role="menubar"` on the bar and `role="menuitem"` on each button, and keeps one Tab stop that follows focus. Left and Right move along the bar and wrap, Home and End go to the ends, and both mirror in RTL. Down, Enter and Space open a menu on its first item. In an open menu, Left and Right open the neighbouring menu unless the focused row opens or closes a submenu. Escape closes it and returns to the bar. `AutoInit()` starts it after Menu, and its `menuOptions` (default `{ constrainWidth: false, coverTrigger: false }`) replace each item's Menu options. Name the bar with `aria-label`.

#### Syntax

```html
<div class="menubar" aria-label="Editor">
  <button type="button" class="menu-trigger" data-target="file-menu">File</button>
  <button type="button" class="menu-trigger" data-target="edit-menu">Edit</button>
</div>
<menu id="file-menu">
  <li><button type="button">New</button></li>
</menu>
<menu id="edit-menu">
  <li><button type="button">Undo</button></li>
</menu>
```

#### Rules

- `menubar-is-named`: Name the menubar with aria-label, such as "Editor". A page can hold several, and the name says which commands they are.
- `menubar-holds-only-triggers`: A .menubar holds only .menu-trigger buttons. Anything else breaks the menubar's arrow-key order; put the menus themselves after the bar.
